Mask of the Red Death's starting max health before power-ups is 255, which is likely a reference to computing where 255 is the maximum value representable by an eight-digit binary number, and therefore the maximum representable by an unsigned 8-bit integer.

, a recurring antagonistic character and loyal servant of Dracula, who is also depicted as a flying skeleton wearing a worn out robe and holding a scythe.

Mask of the Red Death is the only character in the game to receive an official plush so far. It became available to (pre-)order on 27 September 2024.[1]
The reason why Mask of the Red Death received a plush in the first place is because, in August 2022, an employee from poncle asked, in the

, which character, weapon, or other item, should receive a plush, and players could use Discord reactions to choose what should get a plush.[2] The most voted option happened to be Mask of the Red Death.

Death Spiral has no internal range limit, instead expiring once it leaves the player’s screen. Due to Mask of the Red Death’s high speed, the player can catch up to and stack Death Spiral projectiles endlessly by just not letting them go off-screen.
